paragraphs.source_en: Yashirō fell silent again. He could not believe that a woman who had given herself to a man could suddenly become so vulnerable. The first man to whom she had given herself was his lord, Ieyasu. Yet now she cursed Ieyasu and had even gone so far as to seduce one of his retainers of her own accord. This was no weakness; it was an incomparable strength, so formidable that even Ieyasu was helpless before it!

paragraphs.source_en: Compared with his own wife, Yashirō found Lady Sena’s tender, clinging affection far more alluring. It likely sprang from his anger and bewilderment at the sudden transformation of his life.
